sourceInformation.perspective: Fixed, illustrated third-person island scenes and balance-board overlays
sourceInformation.tech: Shardfall engine in Rust/WebAssembly and WebGPU, HTML, CSS, Canvas 2D and JavaScript; AI Hub session library
sourceInformation.artDirection: Bright, friendly tropical resort with rounded characters and soft pastels
sourceInformation.animation: Procedural Canvas 2D motion; the Shardfall scene and balance hook do not drive the visible game
sourceInformation.audio: Procedurally synthesized music, sound effects and chime-like voices; music defaults to 10%
sourceInformation.online: AI Hub ghost-mode medley, when launched inside a compatible hub
sourceInformation.testing: 13 scripted browser and AI Hub checks, 24 viewport launches and two Rust tests; headless WebGPU software-adapter probe failed; no physical devices or real iOS Safari
sourceInformation.research: Shardfall source and documentation; AI Hub client and harness

testingFeedback: At least five issues: startup injection, missing online progress, unclear labels, overlapping phone HUD and WebGPU device loss.
One critical startup bug was fixed; the WebGPU loss also prevents the engine renderer in the tested software configuration.
The cross-browser viewport sweep with visual inspection, together with the scripted full stay.
The isolated balance-spring unit tests were least useful for end-to-end coverage, although they passed.
engineFeedback: The Rust game registration and standalone scene provide a useful starting point.
The WebGPU software-adapter run lost its device after the first frame; retaining the instance did not fix it.
The visible Canvas 2D island interface, activity rules, persistence and multiplayer flow.
Integrating a complete browser game into the native simulation; the planned 3D game remains unfinished.
Registered a fit game, island scene and balance spring to establish a native engine hook, but the visible game does not use it.
Provide a complete small example of a custom game with browser UI and observable state.
promptFeedback: The concrete source, detailed design and packaging requirements.
The very large design leaves tradeoffs unclear when the whole scope cannot be completed.
Implementing and validating the full multi-day activity set and online integration.
Prioritize required gameplay milestones and define which simplifications are acceptable.

aiHub.name: Wii Fit Together
aiHub.description: A playable Tippy Cay prototype with simplified balance challenges. Play a local medley with friends or compare ghost performances through AI Hub.
aiHub.controls: WASD or arrow keys to lean, Space to act, Escape to pause; gamepad supported
